Avalon is tucked away off the R772 and offers easy access onto the motorway and is a short walk into Arklow Town Centre.  Motorway, Rail and Bus Links all just five minutes away.   Major supermarkets, local shops and schools are also available close by.   This lovely family home is ideally suited to the growing family seeking their forever home.
